blocks.orig: The Hondo Hondo Udzungwa Forest Tented Camp borders the Udzungwa Mountains National Park in the Kilombero Valley in southern Tanzania. Hondo Hondo means hornbill in Swahili, and the camp got its name thanks to the amazing number of these remarkable birds that make the area their home. Hondo Hondo’s lush green terrain is located on the edge of pristine rainforest and offers excellent views. The camp offers comfortable safari tents with ensuite bathrooms and private terraces, as well as thatched huts. Enjoy an outdoor shower under the bare sky and feel completely at one with nature. The restaurant caters to all tastes, and ice-cold drinks are available in the cosy bar.
blocks.html: In the Kilombero Valley in southern Tanzania, the Hondo Hondo Udzungwa Forest Tented Camp lies on the border of the Udzungwa Mountains National Park. In Swahili, Hondo Hondo means hornbill, and the camp owes its name to the remarkable number of these striking birds living in the area. Hondo Hondo’s green grounds sit on the edge of untouched rainforest, with excellent views. You can stay in comfortable safari tents with ensuite bathrooms and private terraces, or in thatched huts. Take an outdoor shower beneath the open sky and feel truly part of nature. The restaurant has something for every taste, and the cosy bar serves ice-cold drinks.
